post.description: Bearer JWT and current active database user required under normal configuration. Development authentication bypass headers work only when explicitly enabled by server configuration. Existing protected Calculator access; no admin-only or Project owner/creator scope is added to these handlers. Creates the existing Project/Calculation aggregate. calculation.flow_system_id omitted/null stores SQL NULL; supplied Type must exist and match the incoming Group. Existing selected_models and project payload remain required. reference_no supplies the selection number prefix.

500.description: Sanitized internal_server_error on database/storage failure; raw dependency details are not returned. Misconfigured authentication may return missing_user_repository.

400.description: invalid_request_body for malformed JSON/type; validation_error for required fields or nonpositive Type ID; invalid_flow_system for supplied Type with absent/null/mismatching Group; invalid_selected_models for invalid product-model selection.

401.description: Authentication failed: missing_authorization_header, invalid_bearer_token_format, invalid_access_token, unauthorized, user_not_found, inactive_user, or invalidated_access_token.

404.description: calculation_not_found or user_not_found from the existing mapper; Save/Update additionally flow_system_not_found for missing supplied Type (field calculation.flow_system_id).

get.description: Bearer JWT and current active database user required under normal configuration. Development authentication bypass headers work only when explicitly enabled by server configuration. Existing protected Calculator access; no admin-only or Project owner/creator scope is added to these handlers. Type ID/name are always present and nullable under data.calculation. No nested Flow Tables/Fields; use Project Preview for composition.

put.description: Bearer JWT and current active database user required under normal configuration. Development authentication bypass headers work only when explicitly enabled by server configuration. Existing protected Calculator access; no admin-only or Project owner/creator scope is added to these handlers. Full aggregate update. flow_system_id omitted/null preserves selection; supplied Type validates and replaces it. No clear-selection operation. Coordinate Group and Type changes to avoid mismatch. Send existing priority, creator metadata and status when preserving them; these fields are not mandatory runtime validations. Dates are preserved; owner is the authenticated user. Detail does not expose status.

get.description: Bearer JWT and current active database user required under normal configuration. Development authentication bypass headers work only when explicitly enabled by server configuration. Uses existing Project detail access: admin sees non-deleted Projects; other authenticated roles require owner_user_id or created_by_user_id to match. Missing/deleted/out-of-scope Project is 404, not a new 403 policy. Uses the Project detail calculation_id (highest Calculation ID), then its stored Type. No Calculation yields two null components; NULL Type yields flow_system null. Empty tables/fields are []. Inactive Types/children remain readable. Sequential reads are not a transactional snapshot. A failed non-null Calculation/Type dependency returns sanitized 500. Read-only: FE owns code-to-value mapping, manual need_input state and export.
